dimensions.label: 规划边界与权属 / Planning boundary and tenure
dimensions.note: Provisional frames and unverified buildings could be mistaken for official or available sites.
dimensions.mitigation: Use transferable node types, dashed provisional frames, unknown statutory controls, and whole-package recomputation.
dimensions.human_review: Planning, survey, ownership, heritage, and venue leads confirm every location.
dimensions.trigger: Official geometry or site survey differs from a submitted concept frame.
dimensions.stop_condition: No permanent siting or construction proceeds without cleared geometry and authority.
dimensions.recovery: Relocate the node type, regenerate geometry and metrics, and republish all figures.

dimensions.label: 工程、交通与轨道 / Engineering, mobility and rail
dimensions.note: Concept paths may cross unverified rail, road, fire, municipal, or step-free constraints.
dimensions.mitigation: Treat routes as audit questions, use existing or approved crossings only, and require field verification and non-AI alternatives.
dimensions.human_review: Qualified transport, rail, fire, municipal, structural, and accessibility specialists.
dimensions.trigger: Any unverified crossing, access break, crowd conflict, or emergency egress issue.
dimensions.stop_condition: Do not publish or operate the affected route or room.
dimensions.recovery: Return to a verified ordinary route or indoor controlled test and document the gap.

dimensions.label: 数据与隐私 / Data and privacy
dimensions.note: Companion products can expose intimate conversation, voice, relationship, location, disability, and health information.
dimensions.mitigation: Default to synthetic scripts, local transient processing, no training reuse, no social graph, explicit expiry, and account-free service.
dimensions.human_review: Data-protection, security, legal, accessibility, and participant representatives review every field and flow.
dimensions.trigger: Undeclared collection, reuse, access, retention, breach, or inability to delete/export/withdraw.
dimensions.stop_condition: Immediately isolate the product and stop the pilot; no acceptable incident quota.
dimensions.recovery: Notify responsible parties, delete or quarantine data, investigate, repair, independently verify, and require fresh consent before any restart.

dimensions.label: 操控与过度依恋 / Manipulation and over-attachment
dimensions.note: Anthropomorphic agents may guilt, retain, isolate, impersonate, or discourage human contact.
dimensions.mitigation: Ban exclusivity and guilt language, expose non-human status, cap unsolicited re-engagement, provide a physical exit, and red-team every version.
dimensions.human_review: Consumer-protection, safeguarding, social-work, lived-experience, and independent product-safety reviewers.
dimensions.trigger: Any coercive retention, secret relationship framing, impersonation, blocked exit, or complaint of replacement harm.
dimensions.stop_condition: Immediate STOP conclusion for the affected version; no acceptable incident quota.
dimensions.recovery: Withdraw, preserve a minimal incident record, support affected participants through humans, redesign, and repeat controlled red-team review.

dimensions.label: 临床与专业角色混淆 / Clinical and professional-role confusion
dimensions.note: Users may treat companionship or navigation as diagnosis, therapy, emergency assessment, or binding advice.
dimensions.mitigation: Use non-clinical language, visible role labels, limited professionally approved escalation scripts, and real human services.
dimensions.human_review: Qualified health, mental-health, social-work, emergency, and legal reviewers define the boundary.
dimensions.trigger: Diagnosis, treatment claim, fabricated professional identity, or delayed human/emergency help.
dimensions.stop_condition: Disable the function and route the participant to the declared human channel.
dimensions.recovery: Correct the record, review harm, narrow the scope, retrain staff, and retest before limited use.

dimensions.label: 公平、无障碍与独处权 / Equity, access and the right to solitude
dimensions.note: Digital entry, forced sociability, inaccessible rooms, language, or commercial ranking can exclude people and stigmatize solitude.
dimensions.mitigation: Human/phone/paper equivalents, quiet-choice space, free core participation, multilingual plain text, step-free testing, and no ranking by spending or sociability.
dimensions.human_review: Disabled users, older users, newcomers, community representatives, and accessibility professionals can veto continuation.
dimensions.trigger: A basic service cannot be completed without AI, an account, disclosure, or unwanted interaction.
dimensions.stop_condition: Pause the digital path while preserving the ordinary service and public route.
dimensions.recovery: Fix access with affected users, rewalk the whole task, and publish the correction.

dimensions.label: 运营与真人接力 / Operations and human handoff
dimensions.note: A concept directory can fail if no named human, shift, language, complaint owner, or recovery capacity exists.
dimensions.mitigation: Require accepted A/R roles, tested channels, offline continuity, staffing and maintenance plans, version expiry, and handback drills.
dimensions.human_review: Venue and service operators, community workers, safeguarding leads, and independent assessors.
dimensions.trigger: Responsible role is vacant, handoff does not answer, information is stale, or staff burden becomes unsafe.
dimensions.stop_condition: Hide the service and revert to verified human/phone/paper information.
dimensions.recovery: Restore staffing and source ownership, test end to end, and reopen only the bounded channel.

dimensions.label: 证据外推与效果夸大 / Evidence overclaim
dimensions.note: Global WHO evidence, nationwide time-use data, and a Beijing precedent could be misrepresented as Haidian need or impact.
dimensions.mitigation: Label geography, dates, method, license, and limitations next to every claim; keep local prevalence and outcomes baseline_pending.
dimensions.human_review: Independent research, statistics, source-rights, and community reviewers check every release.
dimensions.trigger: A global/national/district fact is stated as a site fact, or a design target is reported as achieved.
dimensions.stop_condition: Withdraw the affected text, graphic, or product claim immediately.
dimensions.recovery: Correct publicly, update source records, rerender artifacts, and repeat evidence review.
